implementation_revision: r3 places source selection after the fixed v6 training-label end and confirmation after source-selection follow-up; identical prefit collection weights are reused by hash; r2 source comparisons remain retrospective diagnostics, no fresh Worlds were created

policy.scope: operating_bank_account including non-AR financing/internal/cash deposits/external/unclassified; no service promotion
policy.selection: train Worlds only; disjoint source firms; candidate and rho chosen by cumulative AR-applied CRPS normalized by origin open amount
policy.sampling: nested deterministic per-firm anchor quotas, never outcome stratification
policy.calibration: week bands 1, 2-4, 5-13; source logloss selection guarded by cash bias and positive/full Brier
policy.context: v6 origin features and v1 accounting reused unchanged; fresh conditional factors each week
policy.cash_bridge: AR applied extinguishes face balance; bank receipt is AR applied minus fee; historical as-of fee/gross ratio
policy.intraweek: observed positive-week daily cash proportions, as-of only; same allocation profiles shared by comparators
policy.revenue_weeks: Tuesday-Monday, first target (origin, origin+7]; origins must be Monday
policy.new_invoice_cash: T4 gross issuance convolved with dated partial-receipt kernel from mature as-of cohorts
policy.other_flows: joint contiguous 13-week blocks from last 730 observed days; preserve classes; never called revenue
policy.outflows: historical recurring schedule shifted one year with observed recent scaling; supplier/capex jointly block-bootstrapped; explicit known_at obligations override recurrence
policy.owner_draw: daily quarter-end order; target/cap bounds inferred from observed history, cap sampled within identified bounds
policy.no_draw_history: no draw inferred, explicitly marked unidentified; no latent buffer/cap inputs
policy.within_class: retain feasible train representative; measure recursive class replay before adding variation
policy.stop: no fresh Worlds if source AR gate, ledger audit, latency or memory fails
policy.old_holdouts: v1/v6 test Worlds may be used for accounting regression only, never selection
policy.fresh: four predeclared new seeds; evaluate once after source lock, pool three MC replicates; ACI off
prohibited: latent stress or buffer/cap as feature
